children.name: Giraffa
children.description: The tallest living terrestrial animals, giraffes are iconic African savanna browsers with enormously elongated necks, patterned coats, and ossicones; four species are recognised, all native to sub-Saharan Africa.

children.name: Giraffa camelopardalis
children.description: The northern giraffe, also known as the three-horned giraffe, is a species of giraffe native to North Africa.

children.description: The Masai giraffe (Giraffa tippelskirchi ), also spelled Maasai giraffe, and sometimes called the Kilimanjaro giraffe, is a species or subspecies of giraffe.

children.name: Okapia
children.description: A monotypic genus containing only the okapi, the giraffe's closest living relative, distinguished by its forest-dwelling habits, zebra-striped hindquarters, and secretive lifestyle in the Congo Basin.
